info.author: Dimi Latoff
info.name: tgshops-integrations
info.summary: Library is intended to provide the integration of the external service or CRM system with the TelegramShops/It allows to configure the relationship between NocoDB list of the products used further to display in the shop/As a resultss the products can be synchronized and updated uppon the request.
